title: Cloud City: Application & Supply-Chain Security: Binary Authorization & SLSA
city_concept: City Guild Assay Marks & Food Purity Seals

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Street vendors were selling flour tainted with chalk dust, stamping fake merchant logos on sacks to fool consumers.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: The Guildmaster introduced the Assay Purity Seal (Binary Authorization): every flour sack was stamped with a wax seal signed by the master inspector.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: City market guards checked the wax seal at the gate; any unstamped sack was immediately seized and burned.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Physical wax seals can be forged; digital cryptographic attestations use asymmetric 4096-bit RSA keys that are impossible to counterfeit.
